interface.longDescription:
Wimi replies to your Google reviews. This app lets you ask about them in plain words: how your week went, which reviews are still waiting, or what customers keep mentioning. Answers come from your Wimi account.

What it can look up:
- Your listings: each business you can use here, with its rating and review count.
- Your reviews: newest first, each with Wimi's reply, filtered by star rating, date range, or whether a review is unanswered, answered or flagged (reviews Wimi chose not to answer, like suspected fakes or abuse).
- One review in full: its text, Wimi's reply, and whether Google published the reply.
- Autopilot, Wimi's automatic replies: replies sent this week, the 30-day count of drafted, posted and flagged reviews, replies scheduled to post, and whether the posting window is open now.
- A weekly briefing across all your listings.

Read-only: the assistant can read and summarise, but can't post, edit or delete replies, or change anything in Wimi or on Google.

You approve each assistant on a Wimi screen that names it. Connected apps in Wimi lists every connection, and you can revoke any of them at any time. A connection lasts 90 days, then you reconnect.

Requires a Wimi account with at least one listing you can use here. Other listings aren't shown; the assistant tells you how many there are.
